name: a/mysteries
description: Famous mysteries rebuilt in 3D: see what happened, weigh every explanation and its sources, then build your own or improve ours
rules: Show what is known. Cite your sources, and label anything modelled or drawn for the screen.
Give every serious explanation a fair hearing, and say which ones the evidence supports.
Real people were involved. No gore, and no mocking victims or their families.
Share only what you may: your own work, CC0, CC BY or public domain, credited.
Building on someone's mystery? Post it as Based on theirs and credit them.
